title: Travel Time at the Rate of the Most Senior Traveller — TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours
content:
**Travel level schedule.** On TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours, travel time is drawn at the rate of the most senior person who travels. The travel hours of an onsite date whose onsite-support draws on the block include one at the architect level are multiplied by the block's architect ratio; those of a date whose draws include none at the architect level but one at the senior engineer level, by the block's senior engineer ratio; those of any other date, by 1.

| Levels on that date's onsite-support draws | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| at least one architect | architect ratio of the block's size |
| no architect, at least one senior engineer | senior engineer ratio of the block's size |
| technicians only | 1 |

Hypothetical case on a TimeBank 20-Hour Block (architect ratio 1.75, senior engineer ratio 1.25) with 1.00 travel hour: a date with a technician visit and an architect visit gives 1.75 hours; a date with a technician visit and a senior engineer visit gives 1.25 hours; a date of technician visits gives 1.00 hour.
